title: QTile v1 container
description: The `.qtile` tensor sidecar of ARCHITECTURE.md section 10.3. NOTE: a .qtile is a BINARY file, not JSON — this schema documents the header layout for tooling and cross-language readers. The normative definition is `q_tiles::QTileHeader` (crates/q-tiles/src/lib.rs); the byte layout is fixed by `QTile::encode` / `QTile::decode` and pinned by a round-trip test.

binary_layout.description: Byte offsets of the 72-byte fixed header. All multi-byte fields are little-endian, unconditionally, so a .qtile written on one machine reads identically on another.

encoding.description: 0 = RawF32 (lossless), 1 = QuantizedI16 (lossy), 2 = MortonSparseI16 (lossy). Values from a lossy encoding must be labelled approximate and may never be presented as exact weights.

lod.description: 0..=5 per ARCHITECTURE.md section 9.1. Only level 5 may carry exact values.

dimensions.description: Rank of the region this tile covers; 2 for a matrix block.

origin.description: Logical origin within the tensor: [row, column, depth].

$comment: Two fields extend ARCHITECTURE.md section 10.3's in-memory struct so the format is a self-describing FILE rather than a struct: the magic number and payload_len. Two reserved bytes keep `count` 4-byte aligned. Both departures are recorded in docs/decisions/ADR-004-qtile-v1-layout.md.
